hero.headline: Create your personal training plan.
hero.subheadline: From 5K to marathon – plan, share, and export your training sessions. No paywall, no premium features, no commercialization.

features.title: Training planning,
features.description: No generator. No subscription. No data hunger. A professional editor for runners who want to keep control of their own plans.

editor.label: Editor
editor.title: Your plan, your structure
editor.description: Add weeks, enter sessions, define intervals. No wizard, no generator — just a good tool that stays out of the way.

calculations.label: Calculations
calculations.title: Pace & VDOT as guidance
calculations.description: VDOT from your last race time, training paces for different sessions — as a reference point. You decide if that works for you, not the algorithm.

openSource.label: Open Source
openSource.title: No account needed, no tricks
openSource.description: The editor runs in the browser, your plan stays with you. PDF and JSON export without signing up. Open Source on GitHub — you can see exactly what's happening here.

marketplace.label: Marketplace
marketplace.title: Plans that were actually run
marketplace.description: Other runners share their plans — with context, not as a PDF attachment. Browse, clone, adapt. No AI-generated templates.

trust.noAccount: No account needed for the editor

usp.headline: Running belongs to everyone.
usp.body: We don't believe in gatekeeping and commercialization in running. This app was built by runners for runners – no hidden costs, no premium features, no data sales.

roadmap.title: What's Next
roadmap.subtitle: We're working on even more features for the community

ical.title: Your training plan, everywhere you need it
ical.subtitle: Subscribe once, sync forever. Your training sessions appear automatically in Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, Outlook, or any iCal-compatible app.

icalDemo.title: One link. Automatic sync.
icalDemo.subtitle: Click subscribe and watch your training appear instantly
icalDemo.hint: In your real calendar, sessions appear instantly after subscribing

ease.title: Create your plan in seconds
ease.description: No complicated setup, no registration required. Pick your race, set the date – your personalized training plan is ready.

manifesto.headline: No generator.
manifesto.description: I built this editor to move my own training plans from Excel into a structured, simple web interface. You get support from pace and intensity calculations — but you're never overwhelmed.
rejects: Platforms that treat your data as a product
Algorithms that don't explain their reasoning
believes: You know best how your body feels
A plan you understand beats one you follow blindly
Pace and VDOT calculations help — but can't replace intuition
Plans from real runners are worth more than AI output
Your data belongs to you — not us

principles.title: Born from a spreadsheet
principles.body: I originally built this editor for myself — to move my own training plans from Excel into a clean, structured interface. Nothing more.

principles.title: Support, not takeover
principles.body: Pace zones, VDOT, intensity distribution — these are tools. You get guidance, but you decide what goes into your plan. No plan is generated for you.

principles.title: Real plans, real runners
principles.body: In the marketplace you'll find plans that people actually ran. No ChatGPT output, no template. Browse, clone, adapt — that's how this works.

manifesto.ctaHint: See for yourself — no account needed

cta.badge: No credit card · No subscription · No BS
cta.headline: Your plan,
cta.description: Start the editor directly — no sign-up needed. Export your plan as PDF or JSON, or share it with the community using an account.
cta.openSource: Open Source — source code on GitHub

props.title: Free — and stays that way
props.body: The training plan editor is and will remain free. No subscription, no paywall. A marketplace is coming where runners can share their plans at fair prices — the app itself stays free.

props.title: Your feedback matters
props.body: You're here early. Your direct feedback shapes which features we build next and how the app feels.

props.title: Part of the first community
props.body: Early users help shape how the app evolves. We listen, respond quickly, and build this together.
